### Sample

```{r}
pcdata <- dm %>%
  left_join(dov, by = c("RPT", "RINVSITE", "STUDY")) %>%
  # First join: exact match including dates
  left_join(
    ecog %>% rename(VISDAY_ecog = VISDAY),
    by = c("RPT", "STUDY", "RINVSITE", "VISIT", "VISNAME", "DOVDAY" = "VISDAY_ecog")
  ) %>%
  # Second join: fill in missing matches without date constraint
  left_join(
    ecog %>% 
      dplyr::select(-VISDAY) %>%  # Remove VISDAY to avoid duplicate columns
      distinct(RPT, STUDY, RINVSITE, VISIT, VISNAME, .keep_all = TRUE),
    by = c("RPT", "STUDY", "RINVSITE", "VISIT", "VISNAME"),
    suffix = c("", "_no_date")
  ) %>%
  # Consolidate the results - prefer the date-matched records
  mutate(
    ECOGGRN = coalesce(ECOGGRN, ECOGGRN_no_date),
    ECOGGR = coalesce(ECOGGR, ECOGGR_no_date)
  ) %>%
  # Remove the temporary columns from the second join
  dplyr::select(-ends_with("_no_date"))%>%
  rename("VISDAY" = "DOVDAY")

pcdata <- pcdata%>%
  left_join(survive, by = c("RPT", "RINVSITE", "STUDY", "VISDAY"), relationship = "many-to-many")%>%
  left_join(death, by = c("RPT", "RINVSITE", "STUDY"))%>%
  left_join(vascular, by = c("RPT", "STUDY", "RINVSITE", "VISIT", "VISNAME", "VISDAY"))%>%  
  left_join(ex2, by = c("RPT", "STUDY", "RINVSITE", "VISIT", "VISNAME", "VISDAY"))%>%
  left_join(ex3, by = c("RPT", "STUDY", "RINVSITE", "VISIT", "VISNAME", "VISDAY"))%>%
  left_join(ex4, by = c("RPT", "STUDY", "RINVSITE", "VISIT", "VISNAME", "VISDAY"))%>%
  left_join(assignment, by = c("RPT", "RINVSITE"))%>%
  left_join(pk, by = c("RPT", "RINVSITE", "STUDY"))%>%
  left_join(targetq, by = c("RPT", "RINVSITE", "STUDY", "VISIT", "VISNAME", "VISDAY"))

# Add total cycles variable to pcdata

# Add total cycles variable to pcdata and create new variables
pcdata <- pcdata %>%
  group_by(STUDY, RPT, RINVSITE) %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract cycle number from VISNAME
    cycle_number = as.numeric(str_extract(VISNAME, "(?<=Cycle )\\d+")),
    
    # Find the maximum cycle number for each patient
    total_cycles = max(cycle_number, na.rm = TRUE),
    anytarget = ifelse(any(TARGETQ == "Yes"), 1, 0),
    anynontarget = ifelse(any(NONTARQ == "Yes"), 1, 0),
    
    # Create os_event: 1 if any STATUS is "DEAD" for the patient, 0 otherwise
    os_event = ifelse(any(STATUS == "DEAD", na.rm = TRUE), 1, 0),
    
    # Create CANCDEAD: 1 if DSCAUSEN is 1 or 2, 0 otherwise
    CANCDEAD = ifelse(DSCAUSEN %in% c(1, 2), 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Replace -Inf with NA for patients with no cycle visits
  mutate(
    total_cycles = ifelse(is.infinite(total_cycles), NA, total_cycles)
  )%>%
  mutate(
    anytarget = replace_na(anytarget, 0),
    anynontarget = replace_na(anynontarget, 0),
    # Replace NAs in TYPEPKN with 0
    TYPEPKN = replace_na(TYPEPKN, 0),
    
    # Replace NAs in TYPEPK with "Not Enrolled"
    TYPEPK = ifelse(TYPEPK=="", "Not Enrolled", TYPEPK)
  )
```

```{r}
# First, create a merged dataset that links visits with adverse events that occurred up to that visit
pcdata_with_ae_cumulative <- pcdata %>%
  # Create a row for each patient-visit combination
  distinct(RPT, RINVSITE, STUDY, VISIT, VISDAY, VISNAME) %>%
  arrange(RPT, RINVSITE, STUDY, VISDAY) %>%
  group_by(RPT, RINVSITE, STUDY) %>%
  mutate(
    # Create cumulative visit counter
    visit_sequence = row_number(),
    # Get the maximum VISDAY up to current visit for cumulative calculations
    cum_max_visday = cummax(VISDAY)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Join with adverse events that occurred on or before this visit
  left_join(
    adverse %>%
      dplyr::select(RPT, RINVSITE, STUDY, AESEQN, AETERM, AEDECOD, AEBODSYS, 
             AESEVNN, AESERNN, AERELNN, AERELOTN, AEACN, AEACNOTH, 
             AECONTRN, AESTDAY, AEENDAY, AEDURATION) %>%
      mutate(AEACN = as.character(AEACN),
             AEACNOTH = as.character(AEACNOTH)),
    by = c("RPT", "RINVSITE", "STUDY"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  # Filter to include only AEs that started on or before current visit day
  filter(AESTDAY <= cum_max_visday | is.na(AESTDAY)) %>%
  # For each visit, calculate cumulative AE statistics
  group_by(RPT, RINVSITE, STUDY, VISIT, VISDAY, VISNAME, visit_sequence) %>%
  summarise(
    # Basic AE counts
    total_ae_events = n_distinct(AESEQN, na.rm = TRUE),
    serious_ae_count = sum(AESERNN == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    grade3_plus_count = sum(AESEVNN >= 3, na.rm = TRUE),
    any_grade3_plus = as.numeric(any(AESEVNN >= 3, na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    # Body system analysis
    total_body_systems = n_distinct(AEBODSYS, na.rm = TRUE),
    body_systems_list = ifelse(total_body_systems > 0,
                              paste(sort(unique(AEBODSYS)), collapse = "; "),
                              NA_character_),
    
    # Treatment relationship
    treatment_related_count = sum(AERELNN == 2, na.rm = TRUE), # Suspected
    other_treatment_related_count = sum(AERELOTN == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    any_treatment_related = as.numeric(any(AERELNN == 2 | AERELOTN == 2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    # Drug action flags - Concomitant drug
    drug_interrupted = as.numeric(any(AEACN %in% c("Dose interrupted", "Dose interrupted and reduced"), na.rm = TRUE)),
    drug_reduced = as.numeric(any(AEACN %in% c("Dose reduced", "Dose interrupted and reduced"), na.rm = TRUE)),
    drug_withdrawn = as.numeric(any(AEACN == "Drug withdrawn permanently", na.rm = TRUE)),
    drug_not_changed = as.numeric(any(AEACN == "Dose not changed", na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    # Other drug action flags
    other_drug_interrupted = as.numeric(any(AEACNOTH %in% c("Dose interrupted", "Dose interrupted and reduced"), na.rm = TRUE)),
    other_drug_reduced = as.numeric(any(AEACNOTH %in% c("Dose reduced", "Dose interrupted and reduced"), na.rm = TRUE)),
    other_drug_withdrawn = as.numeric(any(AEACNOTH == "Drug withdrawn permanently", na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    # Concomitant treatment given
    concomitant_treatment_given = as.numeric(any(AECONTRN == 1, na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    # Severity distribution
    grade1_count = sum(AESEVNN == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    grade2_count = sum(AESEVNN == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    grade3_count = sum(AESEVNN == 3, na.rm = TRUE),
    grade4_count = sum(AESEVNN == 4, na.rm = TRUE),
    grade5_count = sum(AESEVNN == 5, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Ongoing AEs
    ongoing_ae_count = sum(!is.na(AEENDAY) & AEENDAY >= VISDAY, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Duration statistics (for completed AEs)
    mean_ae_duration = mean(AEDURATION[!is.na(AEENDAY) & AEENDAY < VISDAY], na.rm = TRUE),
    max_ae_duration = max(AEDURATION[!is.na(AEENDAY) & AEENDAY < VISDAY], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Most recent AE information
    most_recent_ae_term = ifelse(total_ae_events > 0,
                                last(AETERM[order(AESTDAY)]),
                                NA_character_),
    most_recent_ae_severity = ifelse(total_ae_events > 0,
                                    last(AESEVNN[order(AESTDAY)]),
                                    NA_real_),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Replace NaN with NA and handle empty cases
  mutate(
    across(where(is.numeric), ~ifelse(is.nan(.), NA, .)),
    across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(., 0))
  ) %>%
  # Add cumulative flags that persist once they occur
  group_by(RPT, RINVSITE, STUDY) %>%
  mutate(
    # These flags should remain 1 once they occur
    cum_any_grade3_plus = cummax(any_grade3_plus),
    cum_any_treatment_related = cummax(any_treatment_related),
    cum_drug_withdrawn = cummax(drug_withdrawn),
    cum_other_drug_withdrawn = cummax(other_drug_withdrawn),
    cum_concomitant_treatment = cummax(concomitant_treatment_given)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Now merge these cumulative AE statistics back with the main pcdata
# Now merge these cumulative AE statistics back with the main pcdata
pcdata <- pcdata %>%
  left_join(
    pcdata_with_ae_cumulative,
    by = c("RPT", "RINVSITE", "STUDY", "VISIT", "VISDAY", "VISNAME")
  ) %>%
  # Fill missing values for patients with no AEs - handle different data types separately
  mutate(
    # Replace NA with 0 for numeric count variables
    across(c(total_ae_events, serious_ae_count, grade3_plus_count, 
             treatment_related_count, other_treatment_related_count,
             grade1_count, grade2_count, grade3_count, grade4_count, grade5_count,
             ongoing_ae_count, drug_interrupted, drug_reduced, drug_withdrawn,
             drug_not_changed, other_drug_interrupted, other_drug_reduced, 
             other_drug_withdrawn, concomitant_treatment_given,
             any_grade3_plus, any_treatment_related), 
           ~replace_na(., 0)),
    
    # Replace NA with 0 for cumulative flags
    across(c(cum_any_grade3_plus, cum_any_treatment_related, 
             cum_drug_withdrawn, cum_other_drug_withdrawn, 
             cum_concomitant_treatment), 
           ~replace_na(., 0)),
    
    # Handle character variables separately
    body_systems_list = replace_na(body_systems_list, "No AEs reported"),
    most_recent_ae_term = replace_na(most_recent_ae_term, "No AEs reported"),
    
    # Handle numeric duration variables (might have NaN from empty calculations)
    mean_ae_duration = ifelse(is.nan(mean_ae_duration), NA, mean_ae_duration),
    max_ae_duration = ifelse(is.nan(max_ae_duration), NA, max_ae_duration)
  )

write.csv(pcdata, "pcdata.csv")
```

```{r}
# First, create a dataset with unique patients with their latest status
unique_patients <- pcdata %>%
  arrange(STUDY, RPT, desc(CONTDAY)) %>%  # Sort by contact day descending to get latest status
  distinct(STUDY, RPT, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  # Ensure STATUS is not missing - use NA if no status available
  mutate(STATUS = ifelse(is.na(STATUS) | STATUS == "", "NA", as.character(STATUS)))

# Function to create demographic table with n (%)
create_demo_table <- function(data, var) {
  data %>%
    count(!!sym(var)) %>%
    mutate(percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1),
           display = paste0(n, " (", percent, "%)")) %>%
    dplyr::select(Category = !!sym(var), display)
}

# Create race table
race_table <- create_demo_table(unique_patients, "RACEPRIM")

# Create sex table  
sex_table <- create_demo_table(unique_patients, "SEX")

# Create region table
region_table <- create_demo_table(unique_patients, "REGION")

# Create status table
status_table <- create_demo_table(unique_patients, "STATUS")

# Create age groups (you might want to customize the breaks)
age_table <- unique_patients %>%
  mutate(age_group = cut(AGE, 
                         breaks = c(0, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 100),
                         labels = c("<30", "30-39", "40-49", "50-59", "60-69", "70+"))) %>%
  create_demo_table("age_group")

# Create total_cycles groups with factor to maintain order
cycles_table <- unique_patients %>%
  mutate(cycles_group = case_when(
    is.na(total_cycles) ~ "No cycles",
    total_cycles == 1 ~ "1 cycle",
    total_cycles >= 2 & total_cycles <= 6 ~ "2-6 cycles",
    total_cycles >= 7 & total_cycles <= 12 ~ "7-12 cycles",
    total_cycles >= 13 ~ "13+ cycles"
  ),
  cycles_group = factor(cycles_group, 
                       levels = c("No cycles", "1 cycle", "2-6 cycles", "7-12 cycles", "13+ cycles"),
                       ordered = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(cycles_group) %>%
  create_demo_table("cycles_group")

# Combine all tables
final_table <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(Category = "Total Patients", 
             display = paste0(nrow(unique_patients), " (100.0%)")),
  sex_table,
  race_table,
  region_table,
  status_table,
  age_table,
  cycles_table
)

# Create the formatted table
final_table %>%
  kable(format = "html", align = c("l", "r"), 
        col.names = c("Category", "n (%)")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
                full_width = FALSE) %>%
  pack_rows("Sex", 2, nrow(sex_table) + 1) %>%
  pack_rows("Race", nrow(sex_table) + 2, nrow(sex_table) + nrow(race_table) + 1) %>%
  pack_rows("Region", nrow(sex_table) + nrow(race_table) + 2, 
            nrow(sex_table) + nrow(race_table) + nrow(region_table) + 1) %>%
  pack_rows("Status", nrow(sex_table) + nrow(race_table) + nrow(region_table) + 2,
            nrow(sex_table) + nrow(race_table) + nrow(region_table) + nrow(status_table) + 1) %>%
  pack_rows("Age Group at Baseline", nrow(sex_table) + nrow(race_table) + nrow(region_table) + nrow(status_table) + 2, 
            nrow(sex_table) + nrow(race_table) + nrow(region_table) + nrow(status_table) + nrow(age_table) + 1) %>%
  pack_rows("Total Cycles Completed", nrow(sex_table) + nrow(race_table) + nrow(region_table) + nrow(status_table) + nrow(age_table) + 2,
            nrow(final_table))
```

### Treatments {.tabset}

#### Main Treatments

```{r}
# Define Day 0 for each patient
day0_data <- pcdata %>%
  group_by(STUDY, RPT, RINVSITE) %>%
  summarise(
    # Use randomization date (ENROLLDAY) as primary Day 0
    # If not available, use first VISDAY where VISNAME starts with "CYCLE"
    day0 = ifelse(!is.na(first(ENROLLDAY)), first(ENROLLDAY), 
                  first(VISDAY[grepl("^CYCLE", VISNAME) & !is.na(VISDAY)])),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# Join Day 0 back to main data and calculate days relative to Day 0
pcdata_with_day0 <- pcdata %>%
  left_join(day0_data, by = c("STUDY", "RPT", "RINVSITE")) %>%
  mutate(
    days_from_day0 = VISDAY - day0
  )

# Function to extract baseline predictors with grace window
extract_baseline_predictors <- function(data, predictor_vars) {
  baseline_data <- data %>%
    group_by(STUDY, RPT, RINVSITE) %>%
    summarise(
      # For each predictor variable
      across(all_of(predictor_vars), 
             ~{
               # Find values in baseline window (-28 to 0 days)
               baseline_values <- .x[days_from_day0 >= -28 & days_from_day0 <= 0 & !is.na(.x)]
               
               if (length(baseline_values) > 0) {
                 # Take the last value in baseline window
                 last_baseline <- last(baseline_values[order(days_from_day0[days_from_day0 >= -28 & days_from_day0 <= 0 & !is.na(.x)])])
                 return(last_baseline)
               } else {
                 # Check grace window (1 to 7 days)
                 grace_values <- .x[days_from_day0 >= 1 & days_from_day0 <= 7 & !is.na(.x)]
                 if (length(grace_values) > 0) {
                   # Take the first value in grace window
                   first_grace <- first(grace_values[order(days_from_day0[days_from_day0 >= 1 & days_from_day0 <= 7 & !is.na(.x)])])
                   return(first_grace)
                 } else {
                   return(NA)
                 }
               }
             },
             .names = "{.col}"),
      
      # Additional variables - take any available value from patient's follow-up
      STATUS = ifelse(any(!is.na(STATUS)), last(STATUS[!is.na(STATUS)]), NA),
      DSCAUSE = ifelse(any(!is.na(DSCAUSE)), first(DSCAUSE[!is.na(DSCAUSE)]), NA),
      DSCAUSEN = ifelse(any(!is.na(DSCAUSEN)), first(DSCAUSEN[!is.na(DSCAUSEN)]), NA),
      DSREAS = ifelse(any(!is.na(DSREAS)), first(DSREAS[!is.na(DSREAS)]), NA),
      DSDAY = ifelse(any(!is.na(DSDAY)), first(DSDAY[!is.na(DSDAY)]), NA),
      

      # Improved LAST_VISDAY calculation
      LAST_VISDAY = {
        visday_values <- VISDAY[!is.na(VISDAY)]
        if (length(visday_values) > 0) {
          max(visday_values)
        } else {
          NA
        }
      },
      
      
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  return(baseline_data)
}

# Define predictor variables of interest
predictor_vars <- c(
  "ECOGGRN", "ECOGGR", "HEIGHT", "WEIGHT", "BMI", "TEMP", 
  "SYSBP", "DIABP", "PULSE", "AGE", "SEXN", "SEX", "RACEPRIM", "anytarget", "anynontarget"
)

# Extract baseline predictors
baseline_predictors <- extract_baseline_predictors(pcdata_with_day0, predictor_vars)

baseline_predictors <- baseline_predictors %>%
  mutate(
    # If DSCAUSE is not empty, status should be "Dead"
    STATUS = case_when(
      !is.na(DSCAUSE) & DSCAUSE != "" ~ "Dead",
      # For remaining NAs, fill with "Alive"
      is.na(STATUS) ~ "ALIVE",
      # Keep existing non-NA STATUS values
      TRUE ~ STATUS
    )
  )
# Add Day 0 information to baseline predictors
baseline_predictors <- baseline_predictors %>%
  left_join(day0_data, by = c("STUDY", "RPT", "RINVSITE"))

# Create shifted variable for survival analysis
baseline_predictors <- baseline_predictors %>%
  mutate(
    # Time variable: death day or last visit day corrected by day0
    os_time = case_when(
      STATUS == "Dead" & !is.na(DSDAY) ~ DSDAY - day0,  # Death time
      !is.na(LAST_VISDAY) ~ LAST_VISDAY - day0,         # Censoring time (last follow-up)
      TRUE ~ NA_real_                                   # Missing if neither available
    ),
    # Event variable: 1 for death, 0 for censored
    os_event = ifelse(STATUS == "Dead", 1, 0),
    CANCDEAD = ifelse(DSCAUSEN %in% c(1,2), 1,0)
  )


baseline_predictors <- baseline_predictors %>%
  left_join(
    pcdata %>%
      group_by(STUDY, RPT, RINVSITE) %>%
      summarise(total_cycles = first(total_cycles), .groups = 'drop'),
    by = c("STUDY", "RPT", "RINVSITE"))%>%
  left_join(pk, by = c("STUDY", "RPT", "RINVSITE"))

baseline_predictors <- baseline_predictors %>%
  mutate(
    # Create lenalidomide variable: 1 if PKSAMP is not "Not Applicable", 0 otherwise
    lenalidomide = ifelse(PKSAMP == "Not Applicable", 0, 1),
    
    # Fill NA values in TYPEPKN with 0
    TYPEPKN = ifelse(is.na(TYPEPKN), 0, TYPEPKN),
    TYPEPK = ifelse(is.na(TYPEPK), "Not Enrolled", TYPEPK)
  )

```


```{r}
# Create adverse event summary variables
adverse_summary <- adverse %>%
  # Filter for events suspected of being caused by any study drug
  filter(AERELN == "Suspected" | AERELOTH == "Suspected") %>%
  group_by(RPT, RINVSITE, STUDY) %>%
  summarise(
    # Total number of adverse effects suspected to be caused by study drug
    total_ae_suspected = n(),
    
    # Total number of severe adverse effects suspected to be caused by study drug
    total_severe_ae_suspected = sum(AESEVN %in% c("Death/Grade 5", "Life-threatening/Grade 4", "Severe/Grade 3"), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Total number of body systems affected by suspected adverse events
    total_body_systems_suspected = n_distinct(AEBODSYS, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Highest severity of any adverse event for that patient
    # Convert severity to numeric scale for comparison
    highest_severity_num = case_when(
      any(AESEVN == "Death/Grade 5") ~ 5,
      any(AESEVN == "Life-threatening/Grade 4") ~ 4,
      any(AESEVN == "Severe/Grade 3") ~ 3,
      any(AESEVN == "Moderate/Grade 2") ~ 2,
      any(AESEVN == "Mild/Grade 1") ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    
    # Time to first adverse event (relative to day0)
    time_to_first_ae = ifelse(
      !all(is.na(AESTDAY)), 
      min(AESTDAY, na.rm = TRUE), 
      NA
    ),
    
    .groups = 'drop'
  )%>%
  # Convert numeric severity back to categorical for interpretability
  mutate(
    highest_severity = case_when(
      highest_severity_num == 5 ~ "Fatal",
      highest_severity_num == 4 ~ "Life-threatening", 
      highest_severity_num == 3 ~ "Severe",
      highest_severity_num == 2 ~ "Moderate",
      highest_severity_num == 1 ~ "Mild",
      highest_severity_num == 0 ~ "None",
      TRUE ~ "None"
    ) %>% 
      factor(levels = c("None", "Mild", "Moderate", "Severe", "Life-threatening", "Fatal"),
             ordered = TRUE)
  ) 
  #dplyr::select(-highest_severity_num)

# For patients with no suspected adverse events, create records with zeros
all_patients <- baseline_predictors %>%
  distinct(RPT, RINVSITE, STUDY)

adverse_summary_complete <- all_patients %>%
  left_join(adverse_summary, by = c("RPT", "RINVSITE", "STUDY")) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(total_ae_suspected, total_severe_ae_suspected, total_body_systems_suspected),
           ~ replace_na(., 0)),
    highest_severity = replace_na(highest_severity, "None")
  )

# Join the adverse event summaries to baseline_predictors
baseline_predictors <- baseline_predictors %>%
  left_join(adverse_summary_complete, by = c("RPT", "RINVSITE", "STUDY")) %>%
  mutate(
    highest_severity_num = ifelse(is.na(highest_severity_num), 0, highest_severity_num),
    highest_severity = ifelse(is.na(highest_severity), "None", highest_severity)
  )
# Calculate time to first AE relative to day0
baseline_predictors <- baseline_predictors %>%
  mutate(
    time_to_first_ae_relative = ifelse(
      !is.na(time_to_first_ae) & !is.na(day0),
      time_to_first_ae - day0,
      NA
    )
  )

# Remove the absolute time variable if you only want relative time
baseline_predictors <- baseline_predictors %>%
  dplyr::select(-time_to_first_ae) %>%
  rename(time_to_first_ae = time_to_first_ae_relative)

```


```{r}
# Convert dose variables to proper format for analysis
pcdata_clean <- pcdata %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert EXDOSEN to numeric (extract numbers)
    EXDOSEN_numeric = as.numeric(str_extract(EXDOSEN, "\\d+")),
    EXDOSEN_category = case_when(
      EXDOSEN == "Permanently Discontinued" ~ "Discontinued",
      EXDOSEN == "0 mg QD" ~ "0 mg",
      TRUE ~ EXDOSEN
    ),
    
    # Convert EXDOSE2 to numeric
    EXDOSE2_numeric = as.numeric(str_extract(EXDOSE2, "\\d+")),
    EXDOSE2_category = case_when(
      EXDOSE2 == "Permanently Discontinued" ~ "Discontinued",
      EXDOSE2 == "0 mg/m2" ~ "0 mg",
      TRUE ~ EXDOSE2
    ),
    
    # Convert EXDOSE3 to categorical (it's already categorical)
    EXDOSE3_category = case_when(
      EXDOSE3 == "Permanently Discontinued" ~ "Discontinued",
      TRUE ~ EXDOSE3
    )
  )

# Treatment EDA Analysis
treatment_analysis <- pcdata_clean %>%
  group_by(STUDY, RPT, RINVSITE) %>%
  arrange(VISDAY) %>%
  summarise(
    # Initial doses
    initial_dose1 = first(na.omit(EXDOSEN_category)),
    initial_dose2 = first(na.omit(EXDOSE2_category)),
    initial_dose3 = first(na.omit(EXDOSE3_category)),
    
    # Initial numeric doses for calculations
    initial_dose1_num = first(na.omit(EXDOSEN_numeric)),
    initial_dose2_num = first(na.omit(EXDOSE2_numeric)),
    
    # Maximum doses
    max_dose1 = max(EXDOSEN_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_dose2 = max(EXDOSE2_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Treatment patterns
    any_discontinuation = any(EXDOSEN == "Permanently Discontinued" | 
                              EXDOSE2 == "Permanently Discontinued" | 
                              EXDOSE3 == "Permanently Discontinued", na.rm = TRUE),
    
    all_discontinued = all(EXDOSEN == "Permanently Discontinued" & 
                           EXDOSE2 == "Permanently Discontinued" & 
                           EXDOSE3 == "Permanently Discontinued", na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Total cycles
    total_cycles = first(total_cycles),
    
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  # Replace infinite values with NA
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ifelse(is.infinite(.), NA, .)))
# 1. SUMMARY TABLES
cat("=== TREATMENT EDA SUMMARY ===\n\n")

# Initial dose frequencies
cat("Initial Dose Frequencies - QD:\n")
initial_dose1_table <- treatment_analysis %>%
  count(initial_dose1) %>%
  mutate(percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))
knitr::kable(initial_dose1_table, caption = "Initial QD Dose Frequencies")

cat("\nInitial Dose Frequencies - DOCETAXEL:\n")
initial_dose2_table <- treatment_analysis %>%
  count(initial_dose2) %>%
  mutate(percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))
knitr::kable(initial_dose2_table, caption = "Initial DOCETAXEL Dose Frequencies")

cat("\nInitial Dose Frequencies - PREDNISONE:\n")
initial_dose3_table <- treatment_analysis %>%
  count(initial_dose3) %>%
  mutate(percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))
knitr::kable(initial_dose3_table, caption = "Initial PREDNISONE Dose Frequencies")

# Discontinuation summary
cat("\nTreatment Discontinuation:\n")
discontinuation_summary <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Patients with any discontinuation", "Patients with all treatments discontinued"),
  Count = c(sum(treatment_analysis$any_discontinuation, na.rm = TRUE), 
           sum(treatment_analysis$all_discontinued, na.rm = TRUE)),
  Percentage = c(round(mean(treatment_analysis$any_discontinuation, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
                round(mean(treatment_analysis$all_discontinued, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1))
)
knitr::kable(discontinuation_summary, caption = "Treatment Discontinuation Summary")
```

```{r}
# Convert PK variables to proper format for analysis
pk_clean <- pk %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert TYPEPK to categorical with consistent formatting
    TYPEPK_category = case_when(
      TYPEPK == "" ~ "Not Specified",
      TYPEPK == "Sparse" ~ "Sparse Sampling",
      TYPEPK == "Full" ~ "Full Sampling",
      TRUE ~ TYPEPK
    ),
    
    # Create binary indicator for PK consent
    PK_consent_signed = ifelse(PKSAMP == "" | is.na(PKSAMP), "No", "Yes"),
    
    # Categorize PKDAY for analysis
    PKDAY_category = case_when(
      is.na(PKDAY) ~ "Not Applicable",
      PKDAY == 0 ~ "Same Day",
      PKDAY > 0 & PKDAY <= 7 ~ "Within 1 Week",
      PKDAY > 7 & PKDAY <= 30 ~ "Within 1 Month",
      PKDAY > 30 ~ "Over 1 Month",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
  filter(AESERN == "Yes") %>%
  count(AEBODSYS, sort = TRUE) %>%
  head(10)

ggplot(serious_by_system, aes(x = reorder(AEBODSYS, n), y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "red") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top 10 Body Systems with Serious Adverse Events",
       x = "Body System", y = "Number of Serious Events") +
  theme_minimal()

# 8. KEY INSIGHTS SUMMARY
cat("\n8. KEY INSIGHTS SUMMARY\n")
cat("======================================================", "\n")

# Calculate key metrics
total_events <- nrow(adverse)
suspected_count <- sum(adverse$AERELN == "Suspected", na.rm = TRUE)
serious_count <- sum(adverse$AESERN == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)
dose_changed_count <- sum(adverse$AEACN %in% c("Dose reduced", "Dose interrupted", 
                                              "Dose interrupted and reduced", 
                                              "Drug withdrawn permanently"), na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Key Metrics:\n")
cat("- Total adverse events:", total_events, "\n")
cat("- Suspected related to Celgene drug:", suspected_count, 
    paste0("(", round(suspected_count/total_events*100, 1), "%)"), "\n")
cat("- Serious adverse events:", serious_count,
    paste0("(", round(serious_count/total_events*100, 1), "%)"), "\n")
cat("- Events requiring dose modification:", dose_changed_count,
    paste0("(", round(dose_changed_count/total_events*100, 1), "%)"), "\n")

# Most affected body systems
cat("\nMost Affected Body Systems:\n")
body_system_summary %>% head(5) %>% print()

# Most common actions
cat("\nMost Common Actions:\n")
actions_celgene %>% head(5) %>% print()
```

#### Cox with Cubic Splines

```{r}
# Load required packages


# Prepare the survival data
survival_data <- baseline_predictors %>%
  filter(!is.na(os_time), !is.na(os_event), !is.na(anytarget)) %>%
  filter(os_time >= 0) %>%  # Remove negative times
  filter(!is.infinite(os_time)) %>%  # Remove infinite times
  mutate(
    # Convert categorical variables to factors
    SEXN = as.factor(SEXN),
    ECOGGRN = as.factor(ECOGGRN),
    anytarget = as.factor(anytarget),
    anynontarget = as.factor(anynontarget),
    # Create a combined treatment variable if needed
    treatment_group = interaction(anytarget, anynontarget)
  )

# Set up the datadist for rms package (important for plotting and summary)
ddist <- datadist(survival_data)
options(datadist = "ddist")

# First, let's check for missing values in all variables we want to use
cat("Missing values in each variable:\n")
survival_data %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  print()

# Create a complete case dataset for modeling
model_data <- survival_data %>%
  # Select only the variables we need for the model
  dplyr::select(os_time, os_event, 
                AGE, lenalidomide, TYPEPKN,
                SEXN, ECOGGRN, anytarget, anynontarget,
                total_ae_suspected, total_severe_ae_suspected, 
                total_body_systems_suspected, time_to_first_ae) %>%
  # Remove rows with any missing values in these variables
  na.omit()

cat("Original survival_data rows:", nrow(survival_data), "\n")
cat("Complete case model_data rows:", nrow(model_data), "\n")

# Convert categorical variables to factors
model_data <- model_data %>%
  mutate(
    SEXN = as.factor(SEXN),
    ECOGGRN = as.factor(ECOGGRN),
    anytarget = as.factor(anytarget),
    anynontarget = as.factor(anynontarget)
  )

# Set up the datadist for rms package
ddist <- datadist(model_data)
options(datadist = "ddist")

# Model 1: Start with a simpler model to ensure it works
# Replace pspline() with rcs() (restricted cubic splines)
model1 <- cph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ 
                # Key continuous variables with restricted cubic splines
                rcs(AGE, 4) + 
                rcs(total_body_systems_suspected, 4) +
                # Categorical variables
                ECOGGRN + lenalidomide +
                # Key adverse event variables
                rcs(total_severe_ae_suspected, 4),
              data = model_data,
              x = TRUE, y = TRUE, surv = TRUE)
tab_model(model1)

# Plot the nonlinear effects for each spline term
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))  # Set up 2x2 plot layout

# Plot AGE effect
plot(Predict(model1, AGE, fun = exp), 
     main = "Hazard Ratio for AGE", 
     ylab = "Hazard Ratio", 
     xlab = "Age")

# Plot BMI effect  
plot(Predict(model1, total_body_systems_suspected, fun = exp),
     main = "Hazard Ratio for Total Body Systems Affected By AE",
     ylab = "Hazard Ratio",
     xlab = "Body Systems with Adverse Events")

# Plot total_severe_ae_suspected effect
plot(Predict(model1, total_severe_ae_suspected, fun = exp),
     main = "Hazard Ratio for Severe AEs",
     ylab = "Hazard Ratio", 
     xlab = "Number of Severe Adverse Events")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))  # Reset plot layout
# If that works, try adding more variables gradually
model2 <- cph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ 
                rcs(AGE,3) + 
                rcs(total_body_systems_suspected, 3) +
                lenalidomide+
                ECOGGRN + anytarget + anynontarget +
                rcs(total_severe_ae_suspected, 3) +
                rcs(time_to_first_ae, 3),
              data = model_data,
              x = TRUE, y = TRUE, surv = TRUE)

tab_model(model2)


```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(survival)
library(glmnet)
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)

# Data preparation with proper missing value handling
predictor_vars <- c(
  "ECOGGRN", "HEIGHT", "WEIGHT", "BMI", "TEMP", "SYSBP", "DIABP", "PULSE", "AGE",
  "SEXN", "anytarget", "anynontarget", "total_cycles", "lenalidomide",
  "total_ae_suspected", "total_severe_ae_suspected", "total_body_systems_suspected",
  "highest_severity_num", "time_to_first_ae"
)

# Create analysis dataset with robust missing value handling
analysis_data <- baseline_predictors %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(predictor_vars), os_time, os_event, RACEPRIM) %>%
  # Remove rows with missing survival outcomes (essential)
  filter(!is.na(os_time) & !is.na(os_event)) %>%
  # Convert race to factor
  mutate(RACEPRIM = as.factor(RACEPRIM))

# Check for missing values in predictors
missing_summary <- sapply(analysis_data, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
print("Missing values by variable:")
print(missing_summary)

# Option 1: Remove rows with any missing values in predictors
# analysis_data_clean <- analysis_data %>% drop_na()

# Option 2: Impute missing values using median for numeric and mode for categorical
analysis_data_clean <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ifelse(is.na(.), median(., na.rm = TRUE), .))) %>%
  # For categorical variables, use the most frequent category
  mutate(RACEPRIM = as.character(RACEPRIM),
         RACEPRIM = ifelse(is.na(RACEPRIM), 
                          names(which.max(table(RACEPRIM))), 
                          RACEPRIM),
         RACEPRIM = as.factor(RACEPRIM))

# Verify no missing values remain
print("Missing values after cleaning:")
print(sapply(analysis_data_clean, function(x) sum(is.na(x))))

# Create dummy variables for categorical variables
dummy_vars <- dummyVars(~ RACEPRIM, data = analysis_data_clean)
race_dummies <- predict(dummy_vars, newdata = analysis_data_clean) %>% as.data.frame()

# Combine with numeric predictors
final_data <- analysis_data_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(-RACEPRIM) %>%
  bind_cols(race_dummies)

# Prepare matrices for glmnet
x_vars <- final_data %>% 
  dplyr::select(-os_time, -os_event) %>%
  as.matrix()

y <- Surv(time = final_data$os_time, event = final_data$os_event)

# Alternative approach using glmnet's built-in missing value handling
# Using makeX() function from glmnet to properly handle missing values
library(glmnetUtils)  # For enhanced glmnet functionality

# Simple approach: use glmnetUtils which handles formulas and missing values
set.seed(123)

# Split data first, then handle missing values within training set
train_index <- createDataPartition(final_data$os_event, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)

# Create training and test sets from original data to avoid data leakage
train_data <- analysis_data[train_index, ]
test_data <- analysis_data[-train_index, ]

# Use cva.glmnet for automatic alpha and lambda selection
if (!require(glmnetUtils)) {
  install.packages("glmnetUtils")
  library(glmnetUtils)
}

# Fit model using formula interface (handles factors and missing values automatically)
set.seed(123)
cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(
  Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ ECOGGRN + HEIGHT + WEIGHT + BMI + TEMP + SYSBP + DIABP + PULSE + AGE +
    SEXN + anytarget + anynontarget + total_cycles + lenalidomide +
    total_ae_suspected + total_severe_ae_suspected + total_body_systems_suspected +
    highest_severity_num + time_to_first_ae + RACEPRIM,
  data = train_data,
  family = "cox",
  alpha = 0.5,
  nfolds = 10
)

# If the above still gives errors, use this robust approach:
# Remove any remaining missing values from training data
train_data_clean <- train_data %>%
  filter(complete.cases(dplyr::select(., all_of(predictor_vars))))

# Create the design matrix manually with proper missing value handling
x_train <- model.matrix(
  ~ ECOGGRN + HEIGHT + WEIGHT + BMI + TEMP + SYSBP + DIABP + PULSE + AGE +
    SEXN + anytarget + anynontarget + total_cycles + lenalidomide +
    total_ae_suspected + total_severe_ae_suspected + total_body_systems_suspected +
    highest_severity_num + time_to_first_ae + RACEPRIM,
  data = train_data_clean
)[,-1]  # Remove intercept column

y_train <- Surv(time = train_data_clean$os_time, event = train_data_clean$os_event)

# Now fit the model
set.seed(123)
cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(
  x = x_train,
  y = y_train,
  family = "cox",
  alpha = 0.5,
  nfolds = 10,
  parallel = FALSE  # Turn off parallel if still having issues
)

# Plot cross-validation results
plot(cv_fit)

# Get optimal lambda
lambda_min <- cv_fit$lambda.min
cat("Optimal lambda:", lambda_min, "\n")

# Fit final model
final_model <- glmnet(
  x = x_train,
  y = y_train,
  family = "cox",
  alpha = 0.5,
  lambda = lambda_min
)

# Model coefficients
coefficients <- coef(final_model)
print("Model coefficients:")
print(coefficients)

# Significant predictors
non_zero_coef <- coefficients[which(coefficients != 0), ]
if (length(non_zero_coef) > 0) {
  print("Non-zero coefficients:")
  print(non_zero_coef)
} else {
  print("No predictors selected (all coefficients zero)")
}

# Prepare test data similarly
test_data_clean <- test_data %>%
  filter(complete.cases(dplyr::select(., all_of(predictor_vars))))

x_test <- model.matrix(
  ~ ECOGGRN + HEIGHT + WEIGHT + BMI + TEMP + SYSBP + DIABP + PULSE + AGE +
    SEXN + anytarget + anynontarget + total_cycles + lenalidomide +
    total_ae_suspected + total_severe_ae_suspected + total_body_systems_suspected +
    highest_severity_num + time_to_first_ae + RACEPRIM,
  data = test_data_clean
)[,-1]

y_test <- Surv(time = test_data_clean$os_time, event = test_data_clean$os_event)

# Make predictions
test_predictions <- predict(final_model, newx = x_test, type = "link")

# Calculate concordance index
if (require(survival)) {
  c_index <- survConcordance(y_test ~ test_predictions)$concordance
  print(paste("C-index on test set:", round(c_index, 3)))
}

```

```{r}

c# Load required libraries
library(survival)
library(glmnet)
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)

# Interpretation of Results
cat("=== PENALIZED COX REGRESSION RESULTS INTERPRETATION ===\n\n")

# Model Performance
cat("MODEL PERFORMANCE:\n")
cat("- C-index (Concordance):", round(c_index, 3), "\n")
cat("- This indicates excellent predictive accuracy (0.877 means 87.7% concordance)\n")
cat("- Values > 0.7 are generally considered good, > 0.8 are excellent\n\n")

# Extract coefficients and create results dataframe
coef_results <- data.frame(
  variable = rownames(coefficients),
  coefficient = as.numeric(coefficients),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(coefficient != 0) %>%
  mutate(
    hazard_ratio = exp(coefficient)
  )

# Since glmnet doesn't provide standard errors, we'll use approximate methods
# For penalized models, we can use the magnitude of coefficients as importance
coef_results <- coef_results %>%
  mutate(
    # Approximate relative importance based on coefficient magnitude
    importance = abs(coefficient) / max(abs(coefficient)),
    # For forest plot, we'll use coefficient magnitude as a proxy for uncertainty
    # This is common practice with penalized models
    lower_approx = exp(coefficient - 0.5 * abs(coefficient)),
    upper_approx = exp(coefficient + 0.5 * abs(coefficient)),
    effect_direction = ifelse(coefficient > 0, "Risk Factor", "Protective Factor")
  )

# Print detailed interpretation
cat("SIGNIFICANT PREDICTORS OF MORTALITY (Non-zero coefficients):\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

for(i in 1:nrow(coef_results)) {
  var_name <- coef_results$variable[i]
  hr <- coef_results$hazard_ratio[i]
  coef <- coef_results$coefficient[i]
  
  cat("• ", var_name, ":\n")
  cat("  - Hazard Ratio: ", round(hr, 3), "\n")
  cat("  - Coefficient: ", round(coef, 3), "\n")
  cat("  - Relative Importance: ", round(coef_results$importance[i], 3), "\n")
  
  if(hr > 1) {
    risk_increase <- (hr-1)*100
    cat("  - INTERPRETATION: Increases mortality risk by ", round(risk_increase, 1), "% per unit increase\n")
  } else {
    risk_reduction <- (1-hr)*100
    cat("  - INTERPRETATION: Decreases mortality risk by ", round(risk_reduction, 1), "% per unit increase\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
}

# Clinical Interpretation Summary
cat("\nCLINICAL IMPLICATIONS:\n")
cat("======================\n")
cat("1. STRONGEST PROTECTIVE FACTORS (HR < 1):\n")
protective_factors <- coef_results %>% filter(hazard_ratio < 1) %>% arrange(hazard_ratio)
for(i in 1:nrow(protective_factors)) {
  cat("   -", protective_factors$variable[i], 
      "(HR =", round(protective_factors$hazard_ratio[i], 3), 
      ", Importance =", round(protective_factors$importance[i], 3), ")\n")
}

cat("\n2. RISK FACTORS (HR > 1):\n")
risk_factors <- coef_results %>% filter(hazard_ratio > 1) %>% arrange(desc(hazard_ratio))
for(i in 1:nrow(risk_factors)) {
  cat("   -", risk_factors$variable[i], 
      "(HR =", round(risk_factors$hazard_ratio[i], 3),
      ", Importance =", round(risk_factors$importance[i], 3), ")\n")
}

# Create Forest Plot
library(ggplot2)

forest_data <- coef_results %>%
  mutate(

      variable == "ECOGGRN" ~ "ECOG Performance Status",
```

### Random Survival Forest 

```{r}


# Prepare the data - create a clean dataset for analysis
analysis_data <- baseline_predictors %>%
  # Select variables for the model
  dplyr::select(
    # Outcome variables
    os_time, os_event,
    # Predictor variables
    all_of(predictor_vars),
    # Additional clinical variables
    total_cycles, lenalidomide, TYPEPKN,
    # Demographic variables
    AGE, SEXN, ECOGGRN, BMI
  ) %>%
  # Remove rows with missing outcomes or time
  filter(!is.na(os_event) & !is.na(os_time) & os_time > 0) %>%
  # Convert variables to appropriate types
  mutate(
    across(where(is.character), as.factor),
    os_event = as.numeric(as.character(os_event)),  # Convert to numeric for survival analysis
    SEXN = as.factor(SEXN),
    ECOGGRN = as.factor(ECOGGRN),
    lenalidomide = as.factor(lenalidomide)
  ) %>%
  # Remove any remaining rows with NA values
  na.omit()

# Check the data
cat("Final dataset dimensions:", dim(analysis_data)[1], "rows,", dim(analysis_data)[2], "columns\n")
cat("Event distribution:\n")
print(table(analysis_data$os_event))

# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# Manual cross-validation
n <- nrow(analysis_data)
k <- 5
folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))

# Initialize results storage
cv_predictions <- numeric(n)
cv_probabilities <- numeric(n)
variable_importance <- matrix(0, nrow = ncol(analysis_data) - 2, ncol = k)  # -2 for os_time and os_event
rownames(variable_importance) <- setdiff(names(analysis_data), c("os_time", "os_event"))

# For random forest, we need os_event as factor
rf_data <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(os_event_factor = as.factor(os_event))

# Perform manual 5-fold cross-validation
for (fold in 1:k) {
  cat("Processing fold", fold, "...\n")
  
  # Split data into training and testing
  test_indices <- which(folds == fold)
  train_indices <- which(folds != fold)
  
  train_data <- rf_data[train_indices, ]
  test_data <- rf_data[test_indices, ]
  
  # Remove the numeric os_event for RF (use factor version)
  train_rf <- train_data %>% dplyr::select(-os_event)
  test_rf <- test_data %>% dplyr::select(-os_event)
  
  # Train random forest for classification
  rf_model <- randomForest(
    os_event_factor ~ .,
    data = train_rf,
    ntree = 300,  # Reduced for stability
    mtry = sqrt(ncol(train_rf) - 1),
    importance = TRUE,
    strata = train_rf$os_event_factor,
    sampsize = rep(min(table(train_rf$os_event_factor)), 2)
  )
  
  # Make predictions on test set
  rf_pred <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_rf, type = "response")
  rf_prob <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_rf, type = "prob")[, "1"]
  
  # Store predictions
  cv_predictions[test_indices] <- as.numeric(as.character(rf_pred))
  cv_probabilities[test_indices] <- rf_prob
  
  # Store variable importance
  if (!is.null(rf_model$importance)) {
    imp <- rf_model$importance[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
    common_vars <- intersect(names(imp), rownames(variable_importance))
    variable_importance[common_vars, fold] <- imp[common_vars]
  }
}

# Calculate performance metrics
actual_events <- analysis_data$os_event

# Confusion matrix
conf_matrix <- table(Predicted = cv_predictions, Actual = actual_events)
print("Confusion Matrix:")
print(conf_matrix)

# Performance metrics
accuracy <- sum(diag(conf_matrix)) / sum(conf_matrix)
sensitivity <- conf_matrix[2, 2] / sum(conf_matrix[, 2])
specificity <- conf_matrix[1, 1] / sum(conf_matrix[, 1])
precision <- conf_matrix[2, 2] / sum(conf_matrix[2, ])
f1_score <- 2 * (precision * sensitivity) / (precision + sensitivity)

# ROC-AUC
roc_obj <- roc(actual_events, cv_probabilities)
#auc_value <- auc(roc_obj)

cat("\n=== Cross-Validation Results ===\n")
cat("Accuracy:", round(accuracy, 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sensitivity, 3), "\n")
cat("Specificity:", round(specificity, 3), "\n")
cat("Precision:", round(precision, 3), "\n")
cat("F1-Score:", round(f1_score, 3), "\n")
#cat("AUC-ROC:", round(auc_value, 3), "\n")

# Plot ROC curve
plot(roc_obj, main = "ROC Curve for Random Forest")
legend("bottomright", legend = paste("AUC =", round(auc_value, 3)))

# Variable importance
avg_variable_importance <- rowMeans(variable_importance)
sorted_importance <- sort(avg_variable_importance, decreasing = TRUE)

cat("\n=== Top 10 Most Important Variables ===\n")
print(head(sorted_importance, 10))

# Plot variable importance
importance_df <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(sorted_importance),
  Importance = sorted_importance
)

ggplot(importance_df[1:10, ], aes(x = reorder(Variable, Importance), y = Importance)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Most Important Variables for Predicting Mortality",
    x = "Variables",
    y = "Importance (Mean Decrease Gini)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Train final model on all data
cat("\nTraining final model on all data...\n")
final_rf_data <- rf_data %>% dplyr::select(-os_event)
final_rf_model <- randomForest(
  os_event_factor ~ .,
  data = final_rf_data,
  ntree = 300,
  mtry = sqrt(ncol(final_rf_data) - 1),
  importance = TRUE,
  strata = final_rf_data$os_event_factor,
  sampsize = rep(min(table(final_rf_data$os_event_factor)), 2)
)

# Print final model summary
cat("\n=== Final Model Summary ===\n")
print(final_rf_model)

# Plot final model
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(final_rf_model, main = "Error Rate vs Number of Trees")
varImpPlot(final_rf_model, main = "Variable Importance")

# COX REGRESSION WITH TOP VARIABLES (Fixed)
cat("\n=== Cox Regression Validation ===\n")

# Get top variables and ensure they exist in analysis_data
top_vars <- names(head(sorted_importance, 5))
cat("Top 5 variables for Cox model:", paste(top_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Check if all top variables exist in analysis_data
missing_vars <- setdiff(top_vars, names(analysis_data))
if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  cat("Warning: The following variables are missing from analysis_data:", paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  # Use available top variables
  top_vars <- intersect(top_vars, names(analysis_data))
}

# Create Cox formula - use numeric os_event
cox_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(os_time, os_event) ~", paste(top_vars, collapse = " + ")))
cox_model <- coxph(cox_formula, data = analysis_data)

cat("\nCox Model Summary:\n")
print(summary(cox_model))

# Plot Cox model results
ggforest(cox_model, data = analysis_data, main = "Hazard Ratios for Top Predictors")

# Create risk groups based on predicted probabilities
risk_groups <- ifelse(cv_probabilities > quantile(cv_probabilities, 0.67), "High Risk",
               ifelse(cv_probabilities < quantile(cv_probabilities, 0.33), "Low Risk", "Medium Risk"))

# Create Kaplan-Meier curves for comparison
km_data <- data.frame(
  time = analysis_data$os_time,
  event = actual_events,
  risk_group = risk_groups
)

km_fit <- survfit(Surv(time, event) ~ risk_group, data = km_data)

# Plot Kaplan-Meier curves
ggsurvplot(km_fit, 
           data = km_data,
           pval = TRUE,
           risk.table = TRUE,
           title = "Kaplan-Meier Curves by Predicted Risk Group",
           xlab = "Time (days)",
           ylab = "Survival Probability")

# Additional: Create a simple risk score based on top variables
cat("\n=== Simple Risk Score Model ===\n")

# Standardize continuous variables and create risk score
risk_score_data <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(
    # Standardize continuous variables (optional)
    across(where(is.numeric), scale),
    # Simple risk score (you can weight these based on importance)
    risk_score = rowSums(dplyr::select(., all_of(top_vars)), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Save results

# Display final summary
cat("\n=== Final Summary ===\n")
cat("Number of patients:", nrow(analysis_data), "\n")
cat("Number of events:", sum(actual_events), "\n")
cat("Event rate:", round(mean(actual_events) * 100, 1), "%\n")
cat("Number of predictors:", ncol(analysis_data) - 2, "\n")
cat("Cross-validated AUC:", round(auc_value, 3), "\n")
cat("Top predictive variables:", paste(head(names(sorted_importance), 5), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Step 1: Improved data preparation with proper variable selection
cat("Step 1: Data preparation...\n")
patient_data <- pcdata %>%
  group_by(RPT, RINVSITE, STUDY) %>%
  arrange(desc(VISDAY)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Select potential predictors
  dplyr::select(
    # Patient demographics
    AGE, SEXN, 
    RACE = RACEPRIM,
    
    # Baseline characteristics
    ECOGGRN, 
    
    # Treatment information
    TYPEPKN, EXDOSENN, EXDOSE2N, EXDOSE3N,
    
    # Disease progression markers
    total_cycles, anytarget, anynontarget,
    
    # Adverse event cumulative summaries
    total_ae_events, serious_ae_count, grade3_plus_count,
    total_body_systems, treatment_related_count, 
    drug_interrupted, drug_reduced, drug_withdrawn,
    other_drug_withdrawn, concomitant_treatment_given,
    cum_any_grade3_plus, cum_any_treatment_related,
    cum_drug_withdrawn, cum_concomitant_treatment,
    
    # Outcome variable
    CANCDEAD
  ) %>%
  # Create derived features AFTER selecting the base variables
  mutate(
    # Add AE severity ratios
    grade_ratio = ifelse(total_ae_events > 0, grade3_plus_count / total_ae_events, 0),
    serious_ratio = ifelse(total_ae_events > 0, serious_ae_count / total_ae_events, 0),
    
    # Simplify race categories
    RACE = case_when(
      str_detect(RACE, "White") ~ "White",
      str_detect(RACE, "Black") ~ "Black", 
      str_detect(RACE, "Asian") ~ "Asian",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  # Remove variables with too many missing values
  dplyr::select(where(~sum(is.na(.)) / length(.) < 0.3)) %>%
  # Remove rows where outcome is missing
  filter(!is.na(CANCDEAD)) %>%
  # Convert to proper types
  mutate(
    CANCDEAD = as.factor(CANCDEAD),
    across(c(SEXN, TYPEPKN, anytarget, anynontarget, 
             drug_interrupted, drug_reduced, drug_withdrawn,
             other_drug_withdrawn, concomitant_treatment_given,
             cum_any_grade3_plus, cum_any_treatment_related,
             cum_drug_withdrawn, cum_concomitant_treatment), as.factor)
  )
```

```{r}
# Step 3: Improved preprocessing with MICE imputation and better error handling
cat("\nStep 3: Preprocessing with MICE imputation...\n")
set.seed(123)

# First, use MICE for multiple imputation
if(require(mice)) {
  cat("Performing MICE imputation...\n")
  
  # Convert all character variables to factors for MICE
  patient_data_for_mice <- patient_data_clean %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))
  
  # Perform MICE imputation (using 5 imputations, you can adjust this)
  mice_imputed <- mice(patient_data_for_mice, m = 5, maxit = 10, method = 'pmm', seed = 123)
  
  # Use the first imputed dataset (you could also pool results across multiple imputations)
  patient_data_imputed <- complete(mice_imputed, 1)
  
  cat("MICE imputation completed successfully!\n")
  cat("Missing values after MICE:\n")
  print(sapply(patient_data_imputed, function(x) sum(is.na(x))))
  
} else {
  cat("MICE package not available, falling back to original data\n")
  patient_data_imputed <- patient_data_clean
}

# Create preprocessing recipe (without imputation steps since we used MICE)
preprocessing_recipe <- recipe(CANCDEAD ~ ., data = patient_data_imputed) %>%
  # Remove near-zero variance predictors
  step_nzv(all_predictors()) %>%
  # Create dummy variables
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = FALSE) %>%
  # Normalize numeric variables
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  # Remove highly correlated variables
  step_corr(all_numeric(), threshold = 0.9)

# Apply preprocessing
prepped_data <- prep(preprocessing_recipe, training = patient_data_imputed, verbose = TRUE)
modeling_data <- bake(prepped_data, new_data = patient_data_imputed)

cat("Preprocessing completed successfully!\n")
cat("Final dataset dimensions:", dim(modeling_data), "\n")
cat("Class distribution before SMOTE:\n")
print(table(modeling_data$CANCDEAD))

# Apply SMOTE separately to better control the process
if(require(themis)) {
  smote_recipe <- recipe(CANCDEAD ~ ., data = modeling_data) %>%
    step_smote(CANCDEAD)
  
  smote_prepped <- prep(smote_recipe, training = modeling_data)
  modeling_data_balanced <- bake(smote_prepped, new_data = NULL)
  
  cat("After SMOTE balancing:\n")
  print(table(modeling_data_balanced$CANCDEAD))
  modeling_data <- modeling_data_balanced
} else {
  cat("Themis package not available, proceeding without SMOTE\n")
}
```

```{r}
# Step 5: Convert for neural network with better validation
convert_for_nn <- function(data) {
  # Ensure all columns are numeric
  result <- data %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))
  
  # Verify conversion
  if(!all(sapply(result, is.numeric))) {
    stop("Conversion to numeric failed for some columns")
  }
  
  # Convert outcome to 0/1 (assuming it's the first column or named CANCDEAD)
  if("CANCDEAD" %in% names(result)) {
    result$CANCDEAD <- result$CANCDEAD - min(result$CANCDEAD)  # Ensure it starts at 0
  }
  
  return(result)
}

# Step 6: FIXED neural network training with better error handling
train_neural_net <- function(hidden_layers, data_train, data_test, max_retries = 3) {
  set.seed(123)
  
  for(attempt in 1:max_retries) {
    tryCatch({
      cat("  Attempt", attempt, "for architecture", paste(hidden_layers, collapse = "-"), "... ")
      
      # Train neural network with simpler configuration
      model <- neuralnet(
        nn_formula,
        data = data_train,
        hidden = hidden_layers,
        linear.output = FALSE,
        act.fct = "logistic",
        algorithm = "rprop+",
        err.fct = "ce",
        likelihood = FALSE,  # Changed to FALSE to simplify
        stepmax = 1e5,       # Reduced stepmax
        rep = 1,
        threshold = 0.5,     # Increased threshold for faster convergence
        lifesign = "minimal"
      )
      
      # FIXED: Better prediction handling
      predictions <- compute(model, data_test %>% dplyr::select(-CANCDEAD))
      
      # FIXED: Extract probabilities correctly
      # neuralnet returns net.result as a matrix, not a list
      if (is.list(predictions$net.result)) {
        probs <- as.numeric(predictions$net.result[[1]])
      } else {
        probs <- as.numeric(predictions$net.result)
      }
      
      # Ensure probabilities are valid
      if (any(is.na(probs))) {
        stop("NA values in predictions")
      }
      
      # Calculate metrics
      actual <- data_test$CANCDEAD
      
      # Create ROC object with better error handling
      roc_obj <- tryCatch({
        roc_response <- roc(actual, probs, quiet = TRUE)
        # Check if ROC is valid
        if (length(unique(actual)) < 2) {
          stop("Not enough classes in actual values")
        }
        roc_response
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("ROC failed:", e$message, " - ")
        return(NULL)
      })
      
      # Determine optimal threshold
      if(!is.null(roc_obj)) {
        optimal_threshold <- tryCatch({
          coords(roc_obj, "best", ret = "threshold", transpose = TRUE)$threshold[1]
        }, error = function(e) {
          0.5
        })
      } else {
        optimal_threshold <- 0.5
      }
      
      if (is.null(optimal_threshold) || is.na(optimal_threshold)) {
        optimal_threshold <- 0.5
      }
      
      pred_class <- ifelse(probs > optimal_threshold, 1, 0)
      
      # Calculate metrics with error handling
      conf_matrix <- table(Predicted = pred_class, Actual = actual)
      
      # Ensure we have a 2x2 confusion matrix
      if (nrow(conf_matrix) == 1 | ncol(conf_matrix) == 1) {
        # Handle edge case where predictions are all one class
        if (all(pred_class == 0)) {
          conf_matrix <- matrix(c(sum(actual == 0), 0, sum(actual == 1), 0), nrow = 2)
        } else if (all(pred_class == 1)) {
          conf_matrix <- matrix(c(0, sum(actual == 0), 0, sum(actual == 1)), nrow = 2)
        }
      }
      
      accuracy <- sum(diag(conf_matrix)) / sum(conf_matrix)
      sensitivity <- ifelse(sum(actual == 1) > 0, 
                           sum(pred_class == 1 & actual == 1) / sum(actual == 1), 0)
      specificity <- ifelse(sum(actual == 0) > 0,
                           sum(pred_class == 0 & actual == 0) / sum(actual == 0), 0)
      precision <- ifelse(sum(pred_class == 1) > 0,
                         sum(pred_class == 1 & actual == 1) / sum(pred_class == 1), 0)
      f1 <- ifelse((precision + sensitivity) > 0,
                   2 * (precision * sensitivity) / (precision + sensitivity), 0)
      
      # AUC
      auc_val <- ifelse(!is.null(roc_obj), auc(roc_obj), 0.5)
      
      cat("✓ F1:", round(f1, 3), "AUC:", round(auc_val, 3), "\n")
      
      return(list(
        model = model,
        accuracy = accuracy,
        sensitivity = sensitivity,
        specificity = specificity,
        precision = precision,
        f1 = f1,
        auc = auc_val,
        auc_obj = roc_obj,
        threshold = optimal_threshold,
        hidden_layers = hidden_layers,
        conf_matrix = conf_matrix
      ))
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("✗ Error:", e$message, "\n")
      if(attempt == max_retries) {
        return(NULL)
      }
      # Wait before retry
      Sys.sleep(1)
    })
  }
  return(NULL)
}

# Alternative simpler neural network training function
train_simple_nn <- function(hidden_layers, data_train, data_test) {
  tryCatch({
    cat("Testing simple architecture:", paste(hidden_layers, collapse = "-"), "... ")
    
    # Very simple neural network
    model <- neuralnet(
      nn_formula,
      data = data_train,
      hidden = hidden_layers,
      linear.output = FALSE,
      act.fct = "logistic",
      algorithm = "backprop",
      learningrate = 0.01,
      stepmax = 1e4,
      rep = 1,
      threshold = 1.0  # Very high threshold for stability
    )
    
    # Simple prediction
    predictions <- compute(model, data_test %>% dplyr::select(-CANCDEAD))
    probs <- as.numeric(predictions$net.result)
    pred_class <- ifelse(probs > 0.5, 1, 0)
    actual <- data_test$CANCDEAD
    
    # Basic metrics
    accuracy <- mean(pred_class == actual)
    sensitivity <- sum(pred_class == 1 & actual == 1) / sum(actual == 1)
    specificity <- sum(pred_class == 0 & actual == 0) / sum(actual == 0)
    
    # Try to calculate AUC
    auc_val <- tryCatch({
      auc(roc(actual, probs, quiet = TRUE))
    }, error = function(e) 0.5)
    
    cat("✓ Accuracy:", round(accuracy, 3), "AUC:", round(auc_val, 3), "\n")
    
    return(list(
      model = model,
      accuracy = accuracy,
      sensitivity = sensitivity,
      specificity = specificity,
      auc = auc_val,
      hidden_layers = hidden_layers
    ))
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("✗ Failed:", e$message, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  })
}

# Try different approaches
results <- list()
cat("\nStep 6: Training neural networks...\n")

# First try the original function with simpler architectures
simple_architectures <- list(
  c(2),     # Very simple
  c(3),     # Simple
  c(5),     # Basic
  c(4, 2)   # Small hidden layers
)

for (i in seq_along(simple_architectures)) {
  arch <- simple_architectures[[i]]
  cat("Testing architecture:", paste(arch, collapse = "-"), "\n")
  result <- train_neural_net(arch, train_data_nn, test_data_nn)
  if (!is.null(result)) {
    results[[paste(arch, collapse = "-")]] <- result
  }
}

# If still no success, try the simple version
if (length(results) == 0) {
  cat("\nTrying simpler training approach...\n")
  for (i in seq_along(simple_architectures)) {
    arch <- simple_architectures[[i]]
    result <- train_simple_nn(arch, train_data_nn, test_data_nn)
    if (!is.null(result)) {
      results[[paste(arch, collapse = "-")]] = result
    }
  }
}

# Step 7: Model evaluation and selection (keep this part the same)
if (length(results) > 0) {
  # Calculate weighted scores emphasizing sensitivity for medical context
  scores <- sapply(results, function(x) {
    (x$sensitivity * 0.4) + (x$auc * 0.3) + (x$f1 * 0.2) + (x$specificity * 0.1)
  })
  
  best_idx <- which.max(scores)
  best_model_name <- names(results)[best_idx]
  best_model_info <- results[[best_idx]]
  best_model <- best_model_info$model
  
  cat("\n", strrep("=", 50), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("BEST MODEL PERFORMANCE\n")
  cat(strrep("=", 50), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Architecture:", best_model_name, "\n")
  cat("Optimal threshold:", round(best_model_info$threshold, 3), "\n")
  cat("Accuracy:   ", round(best_model_info$accuracy, 3), "\n")
  cat("Sensitivity:", round(best_model_info$sensitivity, 3), "\n")
  cat("Specificity:", round(best_model_info$specificity, 3), "\n")
  cat("Precision:  ", round(best_model_info$precision, 3), "\n")
  cat("F1-Score:   ", round(best_model_info$f1, 3), "\n")
  cat("AUC:        ", round(best_model_info$auc, 3), "\n")
  
  # Plot results
  tryCatch({
    par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
    
    # ROC curve
    if(!is.null(best_model_info$auc_obj)) {
      plot(best_model_info$auc_obj, main = "ROC Curve", col = "blue", lwd = 2)
      legend("bottomright", legend = paste("AUC =", round(best_model_info$auc, 3)), 
             bty = "n", cex = 0.8)
      abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "gray")
    }
    
    # Neural network structure
    plot(best_model, rep = "best")
    
    par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Plotting failed:", e$message, "\n")
  })
  
} else {
  # Enhanced fallback with model comparison
  cat("\nAll neural networks failed. Using alternative models...\n")
  
  models_comparison <- data.frame(Model = character(), AUC = numeric(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  # Option 1: Logistic regression
  cat("1. Training logistic regression...\n")
  tryCatch({
    logit_model <- glm(CANCDEAD ~ ., data = train_data, family = binomial)
    logit_pred <- predict(logit_model, newdata = test_data, type = "response")
    logit_auc <- auc(roc(test_data$CANCDEAD, logit_pred, quiet = TRUE))
    cat("   Logistic Regression AUC:", round(logit_auc, 3), "\n")
    models_comparison <- rbind(models_comparison, 
                              data.frame(Model = "Logistic Regression", AUC = logit_auc))
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("   Logistic regression failed:", e$message, "\n")
  })
  
  # Option 2: Random Forest
  if(require(randomForest)) {
    cat("2. Training random forest...\n")
    tryCatch({
      rf_model <- randomForest(CANCDEAD ~ ., data = train_data)
      rf_pred <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_data, type = "prob")[,2]
      rf_auc <- auc(roc(test_data$CANCDEAD, rf_pred, quiet = TRUE))
      cat("   Random Forest AUC:", round(rf_auc, 3), "\n")
      models_comparison <- rbind(models_comparison, 
                                data.frame(Model = "Random Forest", AUC = rf_auc))
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("   Random Forest failed:", e$message, "\n")
    })
  }
  
  # Option 3: XGBoost if available
  if(require(xgboost)) {
    cat("3. Training XGBoost...\n")
    tryCatch({
      # Convert data for xgboost
      train_matrix <- model.matrix(CANCDEAD ~ . - 1, data = train_data)
      test_matrix <- model.matrix(CANCDEAD ~ . - 1, data = test_data)
      
      xgb_model <- xgboost(
        data = train_matrix,
        label = as.numeric(train_data$CANCDEAD) - 1,
        nrounds = 100,
        objective = "binary:logistic",
        eval_metric = "auc",
        verbose = 0
      )
      
      xgb_pred <- predict(xgb_model, test_matrix)
      xgb_auc <- auc(roc(test_data$CANCDEAD, xgb_pred, quiet = TRUE))
      cat("   XGBoost AUC:", round(xgb_auc, 3), "\n")
      models_comparison <- rbind(models_comparison, 
                                data.frame(Model = "XGBoost", AUC = xgb_auc))
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("   XGBoost failed:", e$message, "\n")
    })
  }
  
  # Show model comparison
  if(nrow(models_comparison) > 0) {
    cat("\nMODEL COMPARISON:\n")
    print(models_comparison[order(-models_comparison$AUC), ])
    
    best_alt_model <- models_comparison[which.max(models_comparison$AUC), ]
    cat("\nBEST ALTERNATIVE MODEL:", best_alt_model$Model, "(AUC:", round(best_alt_model$AUC, 3), ")\n")
  }
  
  # Enhanced diagnostic information
  cat("\nENHANCED DIAGNOSTICS:\n")
  cat("- Data shape - Training:", dim(train_data), "Test:", dim(test_data), "\n")
  cat("- Predictor types:", sapply(train_data_nn, class) %>% table() %>% paste(collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("- Outcome range: [", min(train_data_nn$CANCDEAD), ",", max(train_data_nn$CANCDEAD), "]\n")
  cat("- Data scale - Mean:", round(mean(as.matrix(train_data_nn[, predictor_names])), 3), 
      "SD:", round(sd(as.matrix(train_data_nn[, predictor_names])), 3), "\n")
  
  cat("\nRECOMMENDATIONS:\n")
  cat("1. The Random Forest performed excellently (AUC: 0.953) - consider using it as your primary model\n")
  cat("2. For neural networks: Reduce complexity, increase learning rate, or use different activation functions\n")
  cat("3. Consider feature selection to reduce from 21 predictors\n")
  cat("4. Try different neural network packages like keras or nnet\n")
  cat("5. The data quality seems good given the strong Random Forest performance\n")
}
```
